newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Monday:

Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said Commission President Jacques Santer would meet the President of Hungary Mr Arpad Goncz in the afternoon and would be available to talk to the press at 1815/1615 GMT in the V.I.P. area.

Spokesman Jesper Jorgensen said the informal meeting with the Environment ministers of the central and eastern European countries (CEEC) had begun at 0830/0630 GMT. The CEEC countries needed to identify their own approximation strategy, he said. Among other issues, the ministers would tackle the problems of water waste and air pollution, he added.

Jorgensen also said that the Commission would set up a help desk in DGXI to help the CEEC countries with technical questions related to the environment. He said a Commission official from DGXI would give an informal briefing on the meeting and the strategies the CEEC should adopt at 1400/1200 GMT in the spokesman's office.

Spokesman Peter Guilford said the Commission would ask the Trade Council in October to add the D'Amato legislation against Iran and Libya to the same anti-boycott law as the one directed at the Helms-Burton legislation. This would not change the legislation, he said.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/832: Commission opens detailed inquiry into Coca-Cola enterprises' acquisition of Amalgamated Beverages Great Britain Limited.
- Speech/96/206: Speech by Commissioner Padraig Flynn on "The Future of Social Protection in the European Union".
- Speech/96/211: Address by Commissioner Neil Kinnock on "The Liberalisation of European Industry".
- Memo/96/88rev.: Calendar of the week of Sept 16 to Sept 22, 1996.
- Eurostat News release No 57/96: EU employment: 10.7% in June and July.
